name: Conservatory
description: A large old building with a concert hall, classrooms, an organ, and endless corridors from which music constantly drifts.

scenes.name: Great Hall
scenes.description: A shimmering orb hangs on the empty stage in front of the orchestra pit. An A-sharp note is clearly visible at its very center.

scenes.name: Rehearsal Room
scenes.description: A grand piano, several music stands, and an enormous double bass fill the cramped room. From behind the double bass comes an occasional, distinctly unmusical bleat.

scenes.name: Organ Balcony
scenes.description: The whole hall is visible from above. The old organ is silent, but sometimes one of its pipes answers footsteps with a quiet, low hum.

scenes.name: Refreshment Counter
scenes.description: Cups, pastries, and jugs of milk stand behind glass. A faded note hangs on the wall: "Good cheese begins with good milk and patience."
